Author: linusfr
Name: Chat Fade
Punchline: Fades the chat log out when nobody has said anything for a while.
Description: The chat log sits there whether or not it has anything to show. Chat Fade dims it away after a quiet stretch and brings it back the moment someone talks, you start typing, or a situation you chose to keep it up for begins. Combat spam does not count as conversation unless you say it does.
